text: きが　のらないん　だけどなあ…　しょうが　ない！

structure.jp: きが　のらないん　だけどなあ…
structure.en: I'm not really in the mood, though...

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the line a feeling of 'the thing is...'. きが　のらないん　だ = 'the thing is, I'm not in the mood'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but' or 'though', and here it trails off without saying the rest. のらないん　だけど = 'I'm not in the mood, though...'.
